table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	A.ManfCode, 
	ManfName =(SELECT name FROM Manufacturer WHERE ManfCode=A.ManfCode),
	totalpurchases = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(P.InvTotal) FROM PurLedger P WHERE P.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate), 0),
	purchase=ROUND((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(((PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.purprice ) * 
			(1 - (.01 *  PD.discperc))), 0)
		 FROM purdetail PD, purledger PL, item I
		 WHERE 
			PL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PL.posted='Y' and
       			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode and
		 	PD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode), 2),
	preturn =ROUND((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(((PRD.looseqty + PRD.packqty ) * PRD.prprice ) * 
			(1 - (.01 *  PRD.discperc))), 0)
		 FROM prdetail PRD, prledger PRL, item I
		 WHERE
			PRL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PRL.posted='Y' and
       			PRL.prinvcode=PRD.prinvcode and
		 	PRD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode), 2),
	purchaseqty=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(PD.looseqty + PD.packqty *PD.packunits) ,0 )
		 FROM purdetail PD, purledger PL, item I
		 WHERE 
			PL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PL.posted='Y' and
       			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode and
		 	PD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode), 

	preturnqty =(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(PRD.looseqty + PRD.packqty*PRD.packunits ), 0)
		 FROM prdetail PRD, prledger PRL, item I
		 WHERE 
			PRL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PRL.posted='Y' and
       			PRL.prinvcode=PRD.prinvcode and
		 	PRD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode),

	NetPurchase=ROUND((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(((PD.looseqty + PD.packqty ) * PD.purprice ) * 
			(1 - (.01 *  PD.discperc))), 0)
		 FROM purdetail PD, purledger PL, item I
		 WHERE 
			PL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PL.posted='Y' and
       			PL.purinvcode=PD.purinvcode and
		 	PD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode), 2) -
		 ROUND((SELECT ISNULL( SUM(((PRD.looseqty + PRD.packqty ) * PRD.prprice ) * 
			(1 - (.01 *  PRD.discperc))), 0)
		 FROM prdetail PRD, prledger PRL, item I
		 WHERE 
			PRL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			PRL.posted='Y' and
       			PRL.prinvcode=PRD.prinvcode and
		 	PRD.icode=I.icode AND
		 	I.ManfCode=A.ManfCode), 2),
	totaldisc = (SELECT SUM(flatdisc) FROM purledger p
		     WHERE P.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and P.posted='Y' and
				p.purinvcode in (select distinct p.purinvcode 
										from purdetail d, purledger h, item i
										where h.purinvcode=d.purinvcode AND h.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and h.posted='Y' AND d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode))),
	misccharg= (SELECT SUM(misccharges) FROM  purledger p
		    WHERE p.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and p.posted='Y' and
				p.purinvcode in (select distinct p.purinvcode 
										from purdetail d, purledger h, item i
										where h.purinvcode=d.purinvcode AND h.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and h.posted='Y' AND d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode))),
	totalinvdiscperc= (SELECT SUM(ISNULL(B.invdiscperc,0))
		     	   FROM
				  (SELECT invdiscperc = IsNull(SUM(Round(((d.looseqty + d.packqty ) * 
							d.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * p.discperc, 0)
		 		  FROM     purledger p, purdetail d, item i
			   	  WHERE p.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
					  p.posted='Y' and p.purinvcode = d.purinvcode  AND d.icode = i.icode AND i.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode)
				  GROUP BY p.purinvcode, p.discperc) AS  B),
	diff=(select Round(sum ( ISNULL(B.diff,0)), 2)
	      from
		(SELECT p.purinvcode, Diff=ROUND(SUM((d.looseqty + d.packqty) * d.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * p.discperc)) + 
				p.misccharges + p.salestax - p.flatdisc, ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0)) - 
				(SUM((d.looseqty + d.packqty) * d.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * p.discperc)) + 
				p.misccharges + p.salestax - p.flatdisc)
		FROM purledger p, purdetail d, item i
		WHERE	p.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			p.posted='Y' and
			p.purinvcode = d.purinvcode AND d.icode = i.icode AND i.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode)
		GROUP BY p.purinvcode, p.suppcode, p.purcatcode, p.postdate, p.discperc,
			 p.misccharges, p.salestax, p.flatdisc, p.InvGSTPerc1) as B),
	SalesTax = 
		(SELECT ISNULL(Sum (ISNull(S.SaleTax,0)),0)
		FROM  (SELECT	SaleTax=ROUND(SUM((d.looseqty + d.packqty + d.bonusqty) * d.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((d.looseqty + d.packqty) * d.purprice * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)) * 
				d.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((d.looseqty + d.packqty) * d.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * d.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * p.discperc)) - p.flatdisc) * 
				(p.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0))
		FROM dbo.Purledger P, dbo.Purdetail D, item i
		WHERE	
			P.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate  And
			P.posted='Y' and 
			P.purinvcode = D.purinvcode AND d.icode = i.icode AND i.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode)
		GROUP BY P.purinvcode, 
			 P.invgstperc1, 
			 P.misccharges,   
			 P.flatdisc,
			 P.discperc) AS S)	

FROM 	
	(SELECT DISTINCT item.manfcode AS manfcode
	FROM	purdetail, purledger, item 
	WHERE	item.manfcode IN (:ar_manfcode) and
		purledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
		purledger.posted = 'Y' and
		purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		purdetail.icode=item.icode   
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT item.manfcode as manfcode
	FROM	prdetail,prledger,item 
        WHERE 	item.manfcode IN (:ar_manfcode) and
		prledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
		prledger.posted = 'Y' and
		prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		prdetail.icode=item.icode) as A
